title: Internal: Closing/Cancelling a Debit Card
summary: This document provides the procedure to close/cancel/deactivate a customer’s debit card (including lost, stolen, suspected fraud, damaged/replacement, no longer needed, or closing the linked checking account). It lists eligibility checks (verification, owner match via user_id, ACTIVE/PENDING status, no pending transactions, no pending refunds with 3–5 business days guidance, and 14-day minimum card age via date_issued), required tool calls (get_bank_account_transactions_9173 for fraud review; unfreeze_debit_card_3893 if FROZEN; close_debit_card_4721), and post-closure impacts (permanent deactivation, recurring payments update, replacement ordering, refunds credited to linked checking).
faqs: What reasons are available for closing or canceling a debit card (lost, stolen, fraud_suspected, damaged, no_longer_needed, account_closing)?
What eligibility requirements must be met before I can close my debit card (including ACTIVE/PENDING status, pending transactions, pending refunds, and 14-day minimum card age)?
If my debit card is FROZEN, what should be done before it can be closed?
If I report the card as lost/stolen or fraud_suspected, is the 14-day minimum card age waived and do pending transactions still process?
If I suspect fraud, should I review transactions or file disputes, and what tool is used to pull the transaction list?
After the card is closed, can it be reactivated, what happens to recurring payments, and where do refunds to the closed card go?
